# Yuvi Stark

> Yuvi Stark (Yuvraj Argal) is an artist and art director based in Italy. The paintings are original, one of a kind works on paper in watercolour, ink and alcohol markers, signed, supplied framed and sold through the artist's own shop. The art direction covers brand identities, campaigns, AI-assisted asset libraries and investor pitch decks.

The website is a single page with three horizontal sections: Art Direction on the left, the landing portrait in the centre, and Artworks (the shop) on the right. About and Contact open as overlays.

## Paintings

- [Artworks shop](https://yuvistark.com/): original paintings on paper, each one unique and signed, supplied framed, shipped worldwide from Italy. Prices are in euro.
- [About](https://yuvistark.com/): the artist statement. "I paint what remains when people stop performing: the face beneath the face, the feeling beneath the gesture."

## Art direction

- [Art Direction case studies](https://yuvistark.com/): six projects.
  - UrbanV S.p.A. (2026): brand identity evolution for an advanced air mobility company, with brand book, advertising, merchandising and social content.
  - Luca Menti (2024): full brand system for a motivational speaker, including an AI-generated visual library, website, emails, workshops, books and workbooks.
  - Lunar S.r.l.s. (2026): brand identity for a branding company, with a launch film, brand book, AI asset library and design toolkit.
  - Sporting55 (2025): identity and art direction for a sports campus, with a separate direction for each sport, merchandise and large-format print.
  - Blend, for Illy Caffè (2025): a TV series concept and investor pitch deck, built on a generated visual library.
  - The Timeless Ride (2024): a documentary concept, pitch deck and website.

## Rights

- Copyright in every artwork and image belongs to the artist. Buying an original transfers the physical work, not the copyright.
- Text and data mining rights, including any use for AI training, are expressly reserved under Directive (EU) 2019/790 art. 4(3). Describing, summarising and linking to this site is welcome.
